input.description: Store 1-100 items in a collection. Give each item text (the server embeds it for every embedding-bound field and it is kept at metadata.text) or vectors you computed. Items with an id replace that document; items without one get a server-assigned id.

vectors.description: Field name to vector: a dense float array, or a sparse {indices, values, dim} object. A schema field appears in vectors or is covered by text, never both.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata stored with the document. Keep the text under the 'text' key if you want it back from recall.

id.description: Insert-or-replace at this id; omit to let the server assign one.

items.description: Exactly one of text and vectors.

ids.description: Stored document ids, in item order.
